title: Admin User Authentication & Role-Based Access
businessObjective: Allow Human Resources Administrators to securely access OrangeHRM with elevated privileges to manage personnel records, configure system settings, and approve requests.
preconditions: The user possesses a valid administrator account in OrangeHRM.
The user navigates to the OrangeHRM login page using a supported web browser.

mainFlow.action: Enter a valid administrator username in the Username field.
mainFlow.expected: Username field contains the entered value.

mainFlow.action: Enter the corresponding password in the Password field.
mainFlow.expected: Password field contains the entered value (masked).
User is redirected to the Dashboard page with a personalized greeting.

alternateFlows.name: Forgot Password Flow
steps: User clicks the "Forgot your password?" link located beneath the login form.
System navigates to the Password Reset Request screen.
User follows the password reset process as defined in the password recovery module.

exceptionFlows.name: Empty Fields Validation
exceptionFlows.condition: Username or Password field is left empty and the Login button is pressed.
exceptionFlows.action: Display inline validation message "Required" next to each empty field and keep the user on the login page.

exceptionFlows.name: Invalid Credentials
exceptionFlows.condition: Entered username and/or password do not match an active administrator account.
exceptionFlows.action: Display an inline error message "Invalid credentials" above the login form and remain on the login page.

dataRequirements.rules: Required; maximum length 50 characters; must match an existing admin account identifier.
Required; minimum length 8 characters; must be stored and compared using secure hashing (e.g., bcrypt).

acceptanceCriteria: Valid username and password should authenticate successfully and redirect to the Dashboard page.
Submitting empty username or password fields should display inline validation messages "Required".
Clicking "Forgot your password?" should navigate to the password reset request screen.
nonFunctionalRequirements: All authentication traffic must be transmitted over HTTPS (TLS 1.2 or higher).
Login response time shall not exceed 2 seconds under normal load.
Account lockout after 5 consecutive failed login attempts to mitigate brute‑force attacks.
